apps.short_description: Open-world indie MMORPG in development. The free Steam Playtest is LIVE NOW - open to everyone, instant access, no key needed. One class fills one role: Attacker, Defender or Supporter. Party up, fight monsters, gather, craft and quest across a seamless world with no instances.

apps.name: Close that strait !
apps.short_description: Close the Strait is an incremental modern warfare tower defense roguelite. Choose between the rival Meridian Compact and Vostra Union, defend your oil with tanks, missiles, aircraft, warships, and submarines, and upgrade after every defeat until you control the strait.

apps.name: Coasting
apps.short_description: A cozy online beachcombing hangout full of little android cats at the end of the world. Sweep the shore with your metal detector, dig up treasure, clean it off, show your friends, and give it a home. The tide brings more tomorrow. Take it easy… you’re coasting.

apps.name: Collapsus
apps.short_description:
COLLAPSUS™ is a one-of-a-kind block-crunching puzzle game all about gravity manipulation and resource management!
Join Leon the Chameleon as you twist, tilt, turn, & flip to solve your way through endless, mind-bending puzzles!

apps.name: Commander's Dilemma
apps.short_description: Build squads of 10 classes for 1v1 hex-based tactics. Alternate squad moves to defeat the enemy commander. Defend, counter, tighten or spread formations, and use formation attacks. Accuracy and evasion shape damage, not random hits. Seize mana points and teleport gates to deploy hidden reserves.

apps.name: Coraline
apps.short_description: A detective visual novel following a young woman named Coraline as she becomes drawn into her father's investigation.

apps.name: Corposlop
apps.short_description: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvest resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make better factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out your limited area.

apps.name: Corrupted Wings
apps.short_description: Pilot a spaceship through a dark alien world in this third-person flying roguelite shooter. Tear through monstrous enemies, combine powerful MODs and items, and take down evolving bosses. Keep moving as pollution drives each region into a frenzy—and build the firepower to break through.

apps.name: Cozy Tent
apps.short_description: Cozy Tent is a quiet, single-player ambience game. Stay inside a tent in the forest while the rain falls: make a hot drink, read, play chess, watch a sky that follows the real clock and moon, and share the tent with a ferret.

apps.name: CrossVeil
apps.short_description: A card battler across four painted worlds. Hire guardians in the Exchange, build a deck for each world and battle through lantern-lit swamps, a neon arcade city, a crooked carnival and storm-torn sky islands. Every guardian brings its own ability to the fight.

apps.name: Cubey Cove
apps.short_description: Cubey Cove is a tiny, cozy island builder. Stack cubes into beaches, hills and ponds, plant woods and build a little village, and make each wish come true. Twenty animals sail, swim and fly in to stay, each with its own habits and a best friend.

apps.name: Cultivator Idle
apps.short_description: An incremental idle xianxia themed RPG where you follow the path to immortality. Craft powerful pills, ascend the ranks of a sect, and face the tribulations of heaven.

apps.name: DeathSlots
apps.short_description: The Rules are Simple: You must reach 1,000,000 Cash --- If you run out of cash you die!! 💀

apps.name: DepraviA
apps.short_description: In this side-scrolling action game, play as Angelica, an angel on a mission to save humanity. Use various weapons to fight, upgrade your skills with the souls of the fallen, and face the toughest foes ahead as you clear challenging stages! Will you save humanity from the brink of destruction?

apps.name: Destroy Buildings With Missiles
apps.short_description: An incremental physics-based destruction game. Destroy buildings to earn money. Spend money to upgrade your arsenal. Destroy some more buildings.

apps.name: Deus Mantle
apps.short_description: Craft, build, fight monsters, discover new technologies and explore an infinite procedurally generated world! Delve into unknown worlds to uncover ancient secrets and return home.

apps.name: DnB Starfighter
apps.short_description: A skill-driven space shooter where the only goal is a better run.

apps.name: Do Not Merge
apps.short_description: A short workplace-horror visual novel. You play as John, a fresh grad on his first day in IT ops. The office looks completely normal—your predecessor’s ThinkPad does not. Read the notes, analyze the logs, and decide who to trust. It all ends today.

apps.name: DONT BE FOOL
apps.short_description: A 2-5 player online co-op puzzle platformer where nothing can be solved alone. Move and one button — that's all you get. Every level teaches one new rule, then asks you and your friends to survive it together.

apps.name: Doorstep Days
apps.short_description: Plan the route, beat the clock. Take food orders around a hand-painted Japanese town, stack deliveries in your bag, dodge jams and keep the food hot. Seven days, rising quotas, a big event every Sunday, and cards that grow your courier between deliveries.

apps.name: Drink Cola. Get a Fighter Jet!
apps.short_description: Collect cola and go after prizes too absurd to be real.

apps.name: Dwarfspire
apps.short_description: Dwarfspire is an idle shopkeeper that sits on the edge of your screen. Manage a shop of hand crafted gear while sending expeditions of dwarves up mountains to gather rare materials and forge new items. Mine ore, craft items and become a master shopkeeper!

apps.name: E-xode: ROM
apps.short_description: A real-time multiplayer 4X set in a persistent galaxy of 729 sectors. Mine the belts, build a fleet, and push past the secured frontier into lawless space where patrols never reach and pirate stations trade with anyone. The galaxy keeps running when you log off.

apps.name: EdNoKa
apps.short_description: Five mini-games where correct answers power the play. Pick one of 36 quizzes (3,600 questions in math, science, social studies and language, ages 8 to 11), then farm, golf, fly or fight your way through it. Built by a family of three.

apps.name: Eldritch Drift
apps.short_description: A cartoon-goth kart racer where drifting wakes the gods. Forge runes into spells, blast rivals with plasma, rift bombs and walls, and race six ghoulish drivers through a haunted mansion and a temple adrift between worlds, alone or in 2-4 player split-screen.

apps.name: em.Path
apps.short_description:
Immersive witch and camping simulator set in a surreal world glitched beyond salvation.
Travel and maintain your RV, pickup strange hitchhikers, study the occult and rewrite the laws of nature

apps.name: Emergency Buddies
apps.short_description: Emergency Buddies is a co-op ambulance sim for up to 4 players about the world's least qualified paramedic crew. Grab a call, floor it across town, and haul your patient to the hospital – alive, ideally! Drive fast and careful, trying to keep patients breathing.

apps.name: Epokborn: From Stone to the Stars
apps.short_description: Survive, build, recruit, and evolve through entire ages of technology, solo or in co-op for up to 6 players. Rise from primitive tools to advanced industry, break into space, and explore your first playable galaxy in Early Access, then expand toward a far larger space experience on the road to 1.0.

apps.name: ERO FIGHTERS
apps.short_description:
Do you have a favorite adult manga theme?!
You play as a self-proclaimed adult manga collector who, for some mysterious reason, is given the chance to challenge the characters from his beloved manga.
Defeat them one by one and turn your fantasies into reality!

apps.name: ESCAPE: The Cabin
apps.short_description: Trapped in a remote cabin, solve over 70 puzzles and uncover your captor's identity in this first-person horror escape-room game. Inspect and combine items, follow hidden clues, and face randomised solutions that change between playthroughs.

apps.name: Evening, Boss.
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror about keeping a London cab firm located deep in the forest running after dark.

apps.name: EVILGARD
apps.short_description: Cannon fire throws you overboard off Morgenwacht. Follow the trail behind a naval blockade and find companions who will fight beside you. A story-driven, single-player fantasy RPG with the party roles of classic MMORPGs.

apps.name: FallChess: Wizard's Chess
apps.short_description: Mount, move, and command chess pieces in a fully 3D duel. Choose your character, ride your piece across the board, and face your opponents up close. Capture pieces, outmaneuver your enemies, and experience chess like never before, brought to life in first-person action.

apps.name: False Crown
apps.short_description: Face the ultimate test of skill as you master challenging raid bosses entirely solo in this action roguelite. Combine items and abilities to cast down the crowned and become the feared slayer of monarchs

apps.name: Femboy Futa Gym
apps.short_description: Save a struggling seaside gym in 12 weeks! Meet a cast of adult femboy and futanari characters, build relationships through your choices, and play 10 gym-themed minigames in a romantic visual novel featuring animated adult scenes and character-specific endings.

apps.name: Fener-G
apps.short_description: Aim, focus and burn with a lighthouse beam to survive each night against creatures rising from the fog. Pick an upgrade at every dawn. A mouse-only arcade survival game.

apps.name: Fishing in the Dark: Lake of Monsters
apps.short_description: A pixel-art incremental fishing game. Hire crews to catch, haul and process fish, gamble on upgrades at the casino, and keep your pile high so the monsters of the lake can't drain it. Then lay siege to each beast and compress the shore to start again, richer.

apps.name: FLEARUN!
apps.short_description: A retro, fast paced multiplayer on foot racing game for up to 4 players

apps.name: FLY GUYS
apps.short_description: FLY GUYS is a 3D open-world flying collectathon game. Play as an owl named Fly Guy, or his love in the sky, Fly Gal, and relax in this cozy atmosphere surrounded by nature. Fly high to discover new locations and explore the map, searching for eggs to rescue them all. Take on challenges, and explore!

apps.name: Forge Flow
apps.short_description: Forge weapons through a fast-paced clicker loop and build momentum as you upgrade your speed and progression.

apps.name: Forgotten Grounds
apps.short_description: Survive alone in a pixel-art wilderness where daylight can kill you. Scavenge abandoned shelters, craft essential tools, and face predators. Plan your expeditions around the sun and weather, because staying indoors won't keep you alive forever.

apps.name: Forty Days Dark
apps.short_description: Forty days of quarantine have failed. Sail a carrier across a world of over 500 unique cities, then fight street by street through Paris, Berlin and Rome in real time, with tanks, gunships and air strikes. Clear the Infected before the world goes dark.

apps.name: FoulKick Soccer
apps.short_description: Six-a-side arcade football with nobody in a black shirt keeping score of your crimes. Charge a super shot mid-jump, put the opponent on the grass with a harsh tackle, and spin a tornado kick into a loose ball. Six players on one couch, or take it online.

apps.name: Free Ball: Volleyball
apps.short_description: Free Ball is a multiplayer volleyball game. Control one player and compete with your team in fast-paced 4v4 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Choose a character with unique abilities and work with your team to dominate the court.

apps.name: Gardenhood
apps.short_description: A cozy multiplayer gardening game where up to 8 players share one island. Grow rare mutated crops, fish the pond, build and decorate your home, and hang out with neighbors in drop-in public lobbies — or tend your garden solo. Plant something weird. Show it off.

apps.name: Gatcha Gear
apps.short_description: Gatcha Gear is a side scrolling platform game where players will face challenging levels while guiding our tiny robot through a series of portals, each leading to a new bizarre and colorful dimension. Immerse yourself in a strange world, challenges, and excitement!!!

apps.name: gates of chaos
apps.short_description: Choose your character and step into the bloody arena! Annihilate zombie hordes and 15 unique enemy types. Buy lethal weapons from the shop; push your power, speed, and range beyond limits. Can you defeat the massive Bosses that spawn every 10 levels? Survive and dominate the arena!

apps.name: Groove Core
apps.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

apps.name: Gun for Your Life
apps.short_description: A top-down Western roguelite shooter. Your bullets land exactly where you aim, so you can shoot past one bounty hunter and hit the one behind him. Build your outlaw between waves, then hide in the bushes or rush in the open. Somewhere out there is the man who put a price on your head.

apps.name: Half-Life 2: Genry's Great Escape From City 13
apps.short_description:
Half-Life 2: Genry's Great Escape From City 13 is a free custom modification for Half-life 2.
The game takes place a month before the events of Half-life 2. The mod is an action, with often changing locations and first-person shooter.

apps.name: Havenhold
apps.short_description: 《决战万界山》是一款洪荒武道题材宗门沙盒网游。武者们通过丰富的技艺制造游戏内的一切物品，并通过集市自由议价赚取武道资粮。积攒财富，加入宗门，建设驻地，携手同门在激烈战斗中与宿敌争夺一统江湖的机会！

apps.name: Hearth Fable
apps.short_description: Hearth Fable is an ink-wash city-building management sim. Start with a blank scroll: gather wood, build trades, govern people, raise exotic beasts, and repel invaders as you paint your mountain-and-sea scroll step by step toward a paradise of your dreams.

apps.name: High School Blood
apps.short_description: Confront your darkest guilt and uncover the terrifying secrets of "St. Alengar School." Navigate bizarre rules, mysterious medicine, and form bonds with 5 unique club presidents. Will your choices lead to a horrific demise, or true love? Your destiny is in your hands.

apps.name: Hina Cast ! : After Dark
apps.short_description: Become Hina, a talented magician from the prestigious Osta Royal Institute! Live a double life as a researcher by day and ManaVision star by night. Defeat magical creatures with flashy combos and spells while making choices that determine Hina's fate and lead to success!

apps.name: Holy Dig!
apps.short_description: Dig away an entire mountain, one rock at a time. Earn coins from digging, buy better tools, and make every swing count. A satisfying incremental game with one very big goal: turn a mountain into an empty space.

apps.name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
apps.short_description: Build your player's basketball career in a single-player management sim. Manage training and recovery, develop skills, weigh contract offers and build relationships with your team. Earn a starting spot and follow simulated games in 2D with play-by-play and stats, or use quick simulation.
developers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
publishers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

apps.name: Horde Lab
apps.short_description: A maze-building tower defense against hordes of thousands. Raise walls, build 15 kinds of defenses, pick a card every wave and unlock a 562-upgrade skill tree. Slow-motion missiles, a boss every wave and endless waves: how far can you go?

apps.name: How to Chemistry
apps.short_description: How to Chemistry is a first-person co-op chemistry simulator, where you run your own lab with no safety regulations. Get an order, use your chemistry skills and deliver.

apps.name: Idle War Legion: WW2
apps.short_description: Recruit soldiers, tanks, artillery and planes into an auto-battling WW2 army of up to 10 slots. Upgrade it and set the formation; it fights on while you're away, or in a desktop mini window as you work. Face 14 themed Bosses, the Infinite Cyber War Tower, 20 vs 20 Grand Army Battles and more.

apps.name: Ilhumia
apps.short_description:
Enter the world of Ilhumia populated by pretty creatures.
Build your deck and fight other players alone or with a friend in this colorful multiplayer card game.
But becareful ! Angel the possessed girl rules on this world.

apps.name: Increment Isle
apps.short_description: Increment Isle is an incremental game about plundering a mysterious island. Destroy everything, discover new resources, strategically buy upgrades and avoid scurvy to become the richest person in the universe!

apps.name: Island Miner
apps.short_description: Island Miner is an automation game about expanding your factories across a vast island empire. Mine and refine ore into advanced materials, connect islands into a production network, then buy new ones with profit from a shifting galactic market. No enemies, no timers, just smart logistics.

apps.name: Ivory Cage
apps.short_description: Descent with your team into the depths of an abandoned theme park to repair its broken machinery, and survive what's still down there.

apps.name: Jester`s Anger
apps.short_description: A fast deckbuilding roguelike boomer shooter where your deck is your ammo. Hurl paint cards, playing cards and tarot spells to smash marble chess pieces to rubble, heal on their shards, and take revenge on The Hands - the giant chess player who ate the Jester's cake.

apps.name: Kitten Wool Cup
apps.short_description: Play solo or with friends in chaotic kitten soccer matches where the ball is a giant ball of yarn. Slide, tackle, pounce, and score your way through the Kitten Wool Cup, earn wool after every victory, and decorate your cozy cat house with furniture as you chase championship glory.

apps.name: Kovan-G
apps.short_description: Be the queen's scent: lead a living swarm of hundreds of honeybees to the flowers with your mouse and carry the honey home to a straw skep. Cook hornets in a heat ball, scatter from diving swallows and keep the colony fed through 12 summer days.

apps.name: LAKESIDE HEAVEN
apps.short_description: For every long story, there is also a short one.LAKESIDE HEAVEN is a short game rooted in dystopian science fiction, packed with a variety of gameplay experiences within its relatively brief runtime.

apps.name: LAST WITCH
apps.short_description: Ten witches marked by fate are drawn to an isolated island to fight until one remains. A single-player Battle royale Simulation on an eroding 6x6 grid. Master 50 weapons and skills to survive, and discover rich story episodes and death records for all 10 witches.

apps.name: Laylines
apps.short_description: Six challengers, one defender, the oldest trophy in sailing. Lead your syndicate from headquarters to the race course: crew, shipyard, sponsors, weather — and match race duels decided on the water, under real racing rules. History isn't bought: it's conquered.

apps.name: Les enquêtes de Grégoire Lefèbvre : Le Serment de Haine
apps.short_description: Play as Captain Grégoire Lefèbvre and investigate the murder of a controversial country priest in this gripping historical detective thriller.

apps.name: Lexomancy
apps.short_description: A fantastical deckbuilding rouguelike, all packed into a traditional word game. Play as a Lexomancer, a magic user who can channel their power through Runic Tiles, and venture fourth on a quest to find the ever elusive Necrolexicon

apps.name: LIMINOID
apps.short_description: LIMINOID is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

apps.name: Little Dungeon
apps.short_description: LittleDungeon is a third-person loot-driven action RPG. Choose from eight classes and tackle seasonal dungeons solo or in online co-op. Collect gear, combine sets and class weapons, and grow through equipment upgrades, weapon refinement and character advancement to shape your own combat style.

apps.name: Little Lands
apps.short_description: Build your world, one hex at a time. Little Lands is a peaceful, low-stress world builder where you gather resources, expand your landscape, and create a world of your own. No timers, no game overs, just build, decorate, and enjoy.

apps.name: Lostade
apps.short_description: Lostade is an arcade style ARPG about robots, character building, mystery, and mass Monsters annihilation that Focuses arround an Endless mechanic where each time you finish the game, it extend with new lore, maps, quests, enemies, items, difficulty and random events !

apps.name: Lovecraft Tavern
apps.short_description: Take over as the manager of a cozy, cosmic-horror tavern. Mix anomalous ingredients into custom cocktails and test them on your unsuspecting patrons. Watch your recipes trigger grotesque Lovecraftian transformations, bend minds, and rewrite the reality of whoever takes a sip.

apps.name: Lucky Shot VR
apps.short_description: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot VR is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

apps.name: Lumia: Street Obsession
apps.short_description: Lumia: Street Obsession — high-octane clicker-puzzle with seductive 3D visuals. Race the timer, break through her defenses, unlock intimate animated scenes and feel the Fever Mode as you drive the wild Latina beauty wild. Fast. Tense. Addictive.

apps.name: Machina Blue
apps.short_description: Become a mech pilot in Machina Blue, where RPG and shooter elements blend together to deliver the soul of retro anime in a unique way.

apps.name: Magna Regna
apps.short_description: Magna Regna combines the nostalgia of the classic medieval RTS genre with a modern look and gameplay. Explore medieval history through various campaigns from the 9th century up to the very last time of knights. Play with your battle-hardened friends against others in multiplayer.

apps.name: Main Street Operator
apps.short_description: Buy a tired neighborhood laundromat and turn it around. Walk the floor, clean and repair machines, manage prices and cash flow, modernize the store, win back customers, pay down the seller note, and decide when the business is finally worth keeping—or selling.

apps.name: Make My Car
apps.short_description: Make My Car - will take you into the automotive world. Starting in a small, old factory, you are given a golden opportunity to become a part of somethin big. Sell cars, expand your factory, hire staff, and develop innovative models to dominate the automotive market.

apps.name: Mantradox Untitled
apps.short_description:
In a new RPG from the developer of Moon River, you are a doctor called to investigate a mysterious illness from the other side of the world.
Featuring a deep story, fast turn-based combat, and reassignable classes, you must cleanse the holy city, and discover the devastating truth behind the plague.

apps.name: Meowmentum
apps.short_description: Run, young Meowcolyte - finish the elders' speed trials and become a conduit of Meowmentum! Harness your paw-kour skills, dash through magic orbs, and race against the world!

apps.name: Metaversus
apps.short_description: Playtest signups are open—request access below. Your consciousness has been uploaded to the metaverse. Promised a utopia, you've instead been recruited into a cyber war for the world's hardware. Fight for map control with your team. Build, buy equipment, fight & destroy enemy builds, repeat.

apps.name: Micro Reinos
apps.short_description: MicroReinos is a first-person action RPG featuring roguelite elements and retro pixel art. Explore a microscopic world, choose your class, develop your skills, and face off against creatures and bosses across ten realms filled with dangers and mysteries.

apps.name: Midnight Bell
apps.short_description: A gothic PvP autobattler. Build a board of werewolves, vampires or monster hunters, arm them with items, then watch them fight another player's team of gothic monstrosities. Halfway through every fight the midnight bell tolls and the monsters transform.

apps.name: Miss Paint
apps.short_description: Edit the levels with classic image editing tools such as scale, rotate, copy, move, and more in Miss Paint; a puzzle platformer that takes place in a nostalgic computer interface! Utilize each different color's unique mechanics and rules to lead Miss Paint to victory!

apps.name: MoncooMoncoo!
apps.short_description: Join Spoony, the little chef, as you explore a dungeon filled with dangerous yet delicious monsters and restore the world's lost flavors!

apps.name: MONOLYTH
apps.short_description:
A Journey of Self-Deflection. MONOLYTH is a single-player arcade game, one-bullet bullet hell experience, and two-character play rolled into one.

One rainy afternoon, we came across three TV screens reflecting on divinity. We decided to capture this in the only way we knew how: By making a game.

apps.name: moorestech
apps.short_description: Factory automation meets anime-style RPG. Harness gears and shafts to power machines and conveyors, building an automated factory. Produce items and research tech, evolving from windmills to fusion as you trace humanity’s tech evolution, then launch a rocket home to uncover the truth of your exile.

apps.name: Moraff's Dungeons
apps.short_description: A faithful remaster of all of the classic, grid-based, first-person, dungeon crawling, RPG gameplay from Moraff's Dungeons of the Unforgiven with options to add in some of the best from Moraff's World and other balance adjustments, all in a modern, accessible interface.

apps.name: Most Jiggly Elimination Challenge
apps.short_description: A 3D physics obstacle course game show set over the ocean. No story, only fun, and only busty, bouncy babes. It's an addictive, yet frustratingly good time, with some great eye candy to keep you going.

apps.name: Mt. Quack Legend
apps.short_description: A single player 2D anime rogue-lite RPG. Join an new born duck girl's adventure in a aggressively cute world. Beat up cute wild creatures and level up to different bird classes as you explore this place.

apps.name: Mushroom Mushroom
apps.short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer. Control a small mushroom, create clones, and swap positions with them. Master clone swapping through puzzles and challenges, explore the many possibilities of this ability, overcome obstacles, and help the mushroom find its way home.

apps.name: My Little Garden
apps.short_description: Grow a cozy little garden while you work, watch videos, or play other games! Plant crops, discover powerful synergies, complete contracts, and automate your farm. Enjoy relaxing idle progression in a compact desktop window — even when you're away.

apps.name: Myriad
apps.short_description: Myriad is a star themed 2D falling blocks puzzle roguelite game. Every other round, enter a shop and strengthen your build. Gaze the stars in the night sky and score incredibly powerful line clears or just plain destroy the board as you see fit. Watch out for the constellations though...

apps.name: Mystics Ablaze
apps.short_description: Mystics Ablaze is a local multiplayer fighting game for 2-4 players where magi, spirits and occultists clash with colorful crystal orbs and explosive teleportation!

apps.name: Naked Ambition
apps.short_description: Naked Ambition is a "training" game with deck building elements in which the player influences a Princess vying for the throne.

apps.name: Nathan Cross: The Dorm
apps.short_description: You are moving into a new dorm and getting to know your new neighbors. But lately, something strange has been going on there. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the old dormitory to uncover its secrets.

apps.name: Neon Rhythm +
apps.short_description:
Every song is a boss fight in this hand-drawn dual-screen rhythm game. 
Time your moves to the beat of the music, or make your own custom tracks.

apps.name: NETWORK & CYBER SECURITY SIMULATOR
apps.short_description: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!

apps.name: Neverpaw
apps.short_description: Fight monsters, explore dungeons, and dive into a fun adventure in a 2D top-down world. Play solo or bring your best friend along in co-op — because every adventure is better together!

apps.name: NEXT OBJECTIVE
apps.short_description:
The objective marker IS the monster.
Play as Tom, a very obedient boy, and teach him how to disobey. Leave the playable area, break the rules, and fight back against a game that wants you to stay on script.

apps.name: Nezori
apps.short_description: A cute action RPG adventure about a fox girl searching for the legendary hot springs in a world of fox and wolf girls. Help cute fox girls, fight deadly wolf girls, and occasionally come across the playful little fox girl Hana during your journey.

apps.name: NitorInc.: Touhou Microgames!
apps.short_description: (Demo available) An ongoing, collaborative Touhou Project fan game full of rapid-fire microgames YOU can help make! Nitori Kawashiro has brought video games to the fantasy world of Gensokyo, and she intends to capitalize on it with as many diverse games as possible, so you'd better think fast!

apps.name: OBABA: The Terror
apps.short_description: Sixth-grader Azusa finds a body under a cloth in a mountain hut. Then the old woman Obaba appears, and her friend Yutaka is gone. Explore red-brown mountain paths, run as she hunts you, and don't get caught. A first-person 3D survival horror told in chapters.

apps.name: Obol
apps.short_description: A coin-flip roguelite against the clock. Flip coins on a stone altar beside the river of the dead, draft coins and blessings from Charon's offerings, merge them up, and pay the ferryman's toll before his light reaches you. Break the guardian coins and cross five rivers.

apps.name: Olympian Knights
apps.short_description: Play as your favorite Greek God or Goddess and fight for Olympus in Epic PvP Battles against other Gods.

apps.name: ONE SKILL - Drive or Fall
apps.short_description: Test your skills on various platforms and obstacles built high in the sky! Master your driving as you maneuver through thrilling challenges and perilous situations to reach the finish line.

apps.name: Only Animals
apps.short_description: Venture into an endless world of unique biomes and living ecosystems as a nomadic explorer with the ability to capture and transform into over 100 animals. Brave the night, battle powerful bosses, collect mystical hats, and team up with up to 9 friends in a wilderness that never stops growing!

apps.name: Oreflow
apps.short_description: Return to your hometown's abandoned mine and bring it back to life. Mine ore, build drills, crushers and conveyor lines, fix bottlenecks, and restore the deep lift while uncovering what happened to your father. A calm single-player automation game with a quiet mystery.

apps.name: Out of Office!
apps.short_description: A 2-6 player co-op camping game with proximity voice chat. Your behind-the-times tech employer has sent you on a “mandatory-fun” nature retreat in Atlantic Canada. Manage ticks, hunger, a full bladder, and whatever else lurks behind the treeline! Underperform and risk being terminated... ⛺

apps.name: Pack It Up!
apps.short_description: Pack your products in this active incremental game and ship countless orders to your clients. Pay your debt to your supplier before time runs out and earn your freedom.

apps.name: Paddle Quest
apps.short_description: A lighthearted paddleboarding adventure. Navigate hazardous rivers, dodge wondrous creatures, and ride as far as you can — one run, one paddle, no second chances.

apps.name: patiOS
apps.short_description: Explore an operating system and discover the world of computing at your fingertips.

apps.name: Paystreak
apps.short_description: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. Take over a small claim, start by hand, and reinvest every ounce into machines, crews, and new land. Sell when the price is right and turn a struggling camp into a mining empire.

apps.name: PENGUINS VS SEALS
apps.short_description: *Penguins vs Seals* is a side-scrolling strategy game combining RTS, tower defense, and unit deployment. Fuse units to unlock new troops, build defenses, launch attacks, and use battlefield abilities to break enemy lines and claim victory!

apps.name: Perihelion
apps.short_description: Perihelion lets you run your own rocket engine shop. Take over an abandoned desert airfield, design realistic, unique engines, then test them!

apps.name: PGA TOUR 2K21
apps.short_description: Play against the pros. Play with your crew. In PGA TOUR 2K21, you can play by the rules or create your own featuring a new PGA TOUR Career Mode, licensed courses and more! Powered by The Golf Club.

apps.name: Pigeon Online World
apps.short_description: Build your pigeon loft above the neighbourhood. Care for your birds, choose breeding pairs, raise squabs and follow their bloodlines. Develop different breeds' flying abilities through training, enter weekly competitions and grow your loft over time.

apps.name: Plague Genesis
apps.short_description: A night in the forest becomes a fight for survival. Face brutal creatures, explore disturbing places, and uncover the experiments and secrets hidden behind the GENOCYTE Corporation in this 2D pixel-art survival horror.

apps.name: Pledged to a Princess
apps.short_description: A cute and wholesome yuri visual about a young princess, Katarina Mikhailovna Vassilieva, who (finally!) gets to meet her online friend and fellow anime fan, Audrey McMahon. Is the power of cute girls enough to bring a princess and a pauper together?

apps.name: Portal of Nightmares Chapter 1
apps.short_description: Break Reality is a fast-paced, solo-developed low-poly first-person arcade shooter built for pure fun. Set entirely within a stylized low-poly world, it supports up to 30 player multiplayer lobbies

apps.name: Primal Survival
apps.short_description: A realistic prehistoric survival game where you play as Homo habilis or Homo erectus. Craft primitive tools, build shelter, hunt massive beasts, and survive the harsh forces of nature in a vast multiplayer world.

apps.name: Primitive
apps.short_description:
Welcome to the brutal reality of the Stone Age. Fight, conquer, dominate! 
An open world full of traps and unexpected events, breathtaking views, dynamic changes in weather conditions, deadly beasts, and hostile tribes - welcome to "Primitive" and dare to survive.

apps.name: Prophecy Lost
apps.short_description: Prophecy Lost is an extraction RPG where loot is more than just gear: extract with pets, companions, abilities and more. What you take out shapes both gameplay and the unfolding story. Each match escalates toward a catastrophic calamity event—escape before the prophecy brings the world to ruin.

apps.name: Purification
apps.short_description: Purification merges Tower Defense with the exponential growth of an Incremental Idler. Every stage rewards you with souls for talent upgrades and ancient relics that transform your wall into an ever-growing fortress.

apps.name: Purrfect Dice
apps.short_description: A push-your-luck dice roguelite where every die you buy is a cat. Bank what scores, then keep your points or throw again for more. Miss, and the turn is gone. Stack cards and cats that power each other up. The bigger your score, the harder it is to stop.

apps.name: Quiet Time
apps.short_description: An atmospheric survival crafting game where every sound matters. Explore, gather, craft, and use music to awaken the world, influence creatures, and survive.

apps.name: Rally Rush
apps.short_description: A top-down arcade rally game built for one more go. Twelve rallies from forest and snow to a volcanic island and two race circuits, over 60 stages against the clock, a co-driver calling every bend, and new events every day.

apps.name: Rapid Fire Girls - BathMagic -
apps.short_description: Take on simple mini-games, collect sexy illustrations of bathing women, and enjoy admiring them to your heart's content in this digital artbook.

apps.name: Rennspiel
apps.short_description: Up to 16 cars on one screen and no room for manners. A top-down racer in the spirit of the 16-bit era: rockets, mines and oil on the road, eight championships, 2 to 4 players on one machine on pads or the keyboard, LAN, and an editor for tracks of your own.

apps.name: RhizoMana: Arbor Magna
apps.short_description: A cozy adventure for a magic academy graduate: restore the disrupted mana flow, grow the best garden, unravel the mysteries of alchemy, and save a remote village from rampaging slimes.

apps.name: Rift Jumpers
apps.short_description: A top-down co-op survivors roguelite for 1-4 players. Jump into a ruined world with your crew, stack perks on ridiculous guns, mix elemental reactions and survive the horde long enough to bring down the boss. Every run is a new map, a new build and a new way for things to go wrong.

apps.name: Rinha de Waifus
apps.short_description: Be the strategist behind cute waifus in a tactical, chaotic auto battler: set your formations, pick each one's playstyle, then watch it go gloriously right! Or wrong?! Solo campaigns and challenges, online 1v1s against friends, a roguelite Arena and a ranked Ladder for the ambitious.

apps.name: RINO RUSH 2
apps.short_description: Still Snake! But awesome! Everything you eat becomes part of your body: shields, axes, bombs. Rush with your horn, dodge telegraphed boss attacks and free your horde from your evil twin Rhino. With an H.

apps.name: Roadside Store Simulator
apps.short_description: Roadside Store Simulator is a cozy and detailed simulation game where you build, manage and expand your own roadside general store. Stock shelves, serve customers, hire employees and grow your business over time.

apps.name: Rocket Lamps
apps.short_description: The military-industrial complex reaches new heights... at the parks and recreation department of your local municpality! Take to the skies and waste taxpayer dollars with thoroughly in this delightful spin on the age-old lunar landar concept.

apps.name: Rodobus Simulador
apps.short_description: Rodobus Simulator is a driving simulation game that puts you in control of a bus in a world faithfully represented at real scale. Transport passengers, follow routes, and face challenges like dynamic traffic, weather changes, and a day-night cycle.

apps.name: Roundy Wheels
apps.short_description: Take a part in a various types of races on the Kamoa Island. Explore different locations on the map. Customize your car to your needs and become the fastest driver on the island!

apps.name: Runeborn - Ashes of the Realm
apps.short_description: Build your deck, command powerful factions, and forge your own strategy in a fantasy card game. Battle your enemies, collect new cards, explore dangerous expeditions, and shape the fate of the Realm!

apps.name: Saltwake
apps.short_description: Ostrand, December 1999. During a museum preview the alarm goes off, and when harbour officer Ines Varga gets inside, the guests have turned into salt statues. A cinematic action RPG with real-time battles in pre-rendered rooms, over six nights before the year 2000.

apps.name: Samurai Unicorn
apps.short_description: An action horror game with retro-graphics, set in the sprawling megacity of Sydney3.

apps.name: Sepulvia
apps.short_description: Sepulvia is a dungeon crawler RPG set in a psychedelic underworld. Fight ethereal tug-of-war battles and navigate supernatural metro lines to reclaim your best friend's soul from the realm's enigmatic ruler. No matter what happens, BRING. HER. HOME.

apps.name: SharkAndDelivery
apps.short_description: A fast-paced delivery adventure where you play as Shark, a rookie worker at BurgerDash. Dodge obstacles, outsmart enemies, and deliver burgers across tricky levels before the boss fires you. Simple, chaotic, and fun!

apps.name: Sheep Counting
apps.short_description: A recreational software for counting sheep, observing puzzles, and befriending an indoor air-conditioning unit.

apps.name: Shole Soccer
apps.short_description:
Shole Soccer is a chaotic online soccer game where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. 
Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

apps.name: Shoot Lemons and Pay Rent
apps.short_description: A short incremental game about shooting lemons to pay rent. Shoot as much fruit as you can, buy guns and upgrades like chain lightning and gravity fields, and pay your landlord before each bill is due.

apps.name: Silenus
apps.short_description: Uncover the secrets of an oil refinery operated by an obscure organization in this short, atmospheric narrative adventure.

apps.name: SIM SPORTS RACING
apps.short_description: SIM SPORTS RACING redefines virtual motorsport for controllers and keyboards. Built for PC and Steam Deck, it merges arcade control with deep strategy: tire degradation, real-time pit stops, and an async global SSRP ELO Ranking on our servers. No expensive wheels: just pure skill.

apps.name: SKRYZE
apps.short_description: SKRYZE is a lightning-fast one-on-one fighting game where fists give way to steel yo-yos: hurl them across the arena and bend their path in mid-flight. Five fighters, each with their own style.

apps.name: SlimeBreak
apps.short_description: Tower defense against a horde of thousands of slimes. Build walls, towers and traps along a funnel, pick level cards that bend each run, and watch the mass pile up, split and break through. Spend essence between runs to grow stronger.

apps.name: Slimekin
apps.short_description: Feed your slimes enemy remains, armour, magic and strange materials to shape what they become. Explore changing dungeons, build powerful slime teams, discover branching evolutions, and fight your way toward the Demon Lord in this creature-evolution roguelite.

apps.name: Something is Wrong With the Library
apps.short_description: Shelve hundreds of real books in a library haunted by blood and meat. A spooky narrative organizing simulator by the studio behind I Am Your Beast and Clickolding.

apps.name: Somnium Space
apps.short_description: A persistent Social VR platform. Explore community-built worlds, attend live events, express yourself through deeply customisable avatars with full body tracking, built-in social features and build your own experiences using our Unity SDK with full C# scripting.

apps.name: Souls of Avelor
apps.short_description: Slay monsters as a forgotten soul, gather the Souls they carry and reawaken the silent Portals of Avelor. An idle runner RPG that keeps playing while you're away: upgrade at the Forge, Awaken to grow stronger, collect runes, raise a Skeleton Legion and explore dark-fantasy realms.

apps.name: Spellworks
apps.short_description: Spellworks is a single-player dark fantasy tower defense game where tactical real-time decisions shape every battle. Build and upgrade powerful elemental towers, defend the realms from relentless enemy waves, and defeat epic bosses.

apps.name: Splinterra
apps.short_description: Explore flying islands. Capture creatures. Use powerful spells. In this VR rpg.

apps.name: Spot Together
apps.short_description: Two scenes. Small changes. Can you spot them all? Compare seemingly identical scenes, uncover hidden differences, and put your observation skills to the test. Sometimes, the smallest detail makes all the difference.

apps.name: STAR CIPHER
apps.short_description: Turn English vocabulary practice into a sci-fi typing battle. Type answers to stop falling enemies, build combos, and tackle faster waves. Explore 100 chapters with comic dialogues, pronunciation audio, and a practice mode you can play at your own pace.

apps.name: Star-Soldier:Delta
apps.short_description: Star Soldier Delta is a colourful sci-fi shoot ’em up. Pilot your ship through alien battles, dodge incoming fire, boost out of danger and unleash Gatling guns and powerful special weapons. Experiment with different ships and seven shield styles to find your favourite way to fight.

apps.name: StarFear
apps.short_description: Fly. Die. Improve. Repeat. StarFear is a brutal space extraction roguelite where loss is learning, skill is the answer, and nothing feels better than getting out alive, alone or with your friends.

apps.name: Stealing Christmas
apps.short_description: This is your chance to be naughty this Christmas! Loot all gifts and decorations you can find and stash them away! Raid Santa's House and sabotage his Naughty-or-Nice operation! Stealing Christmas is a hidden object collection game with lighthearted humor.

apps.name: Stickman & Wildland Chariot
apps.short_description: This is an action‑survival game that combines highway exploration, vehicle customization and roguelike shooting. Your war chariot is your only hope. Fire up your engine and embark on this endless survival dash

apps.name: Summer for ANT
apps.short_description: Winter is coming; gather the food scattered around. A cozy job simulator where you play as an ANT. The colony needs calories, and you're their only hope. Lead your colony, hire other ants, unlock upgrades, and collect all the food in 8 different areas to make the summer a breeze!

apps.name: Sunfarers
apps.short_description: Captain your ship and the crew living aboard. Lay out their quarters, keep them fed, sane, and watch them work their shifts. Trade, smuggle, explore and fight across six worlds cut off from the universe. Beware bizarre phenomena shaking the system; reality itself can't always be trusted.

apps.name: Sunset Sprinters '98
apps.short_description: Relive the glory days of 1998 in this high-speed precision runner. You have no health bar—only a Snack Meter that drains constantly. Smash obstacles, collect aluminum cans for rental money, find CDs for your SpinDisk, and sprint from the Middle School to MegaHits Video before the sun sets.

apps.name: Sweet Order: Candy Shop Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: A magical candy shop is a sticky mess! Play as an adorable marshmallow in this cozy first-person cleaning and organizing sim. Vacuum up gummies, scrape away syrup, and sort colorful candies to perfection. No timers, no stress, just pure satisfaction!

apps.name: Sydwater
apps.short_description: Welcome to Sydwater, a wide open TPS/FPS sandbox set in a stylized Sydney Australia inspired by the golden age of open world games. Conquer the World and play Activities to get Alms and make friends along the way. The Player can Shoot, Fly, Skate, Tag and traverse to other Dimensions.

apps.name: sys:tan restore
apps.short_description: A (very) short incremental game where you blast shapes to solve computer problems. Put together a party of computer caretakers with their own unique skill trees and give the system a deep clean!

apps.name: Tall Orders
apps.short_description: Tall Orders is a co-op platforming game where you and a friend play as small gnomes tending to a wizard's potion shop for the day. Work together to overcome your size, find the right ingredients, and brew potions. But beware, handling the ingredients may cause strange side effects!

apps.name: Teddy Floppy Ear - The Race
apps.short_description: People of Animalville got a carting fever and you must help one of them reach for the championship. Take the wheel, choose a kart, decide which character from 'Teddy Floppy Ear’ universe you want, and start the wild ride!

apps.name: The Hidden Lot: Bid. Salvage. Restore.
apps.short_description: A single-player storage auction and restoration sim. Win sealed lockers with a flashlight, a UV lamp and a hunch, outbid three rivals, tear them apart in a cut-away view, spot the fakes, and fill your own museum with 2,000+ collectibles.

apps.name: The Landlord's Legacy
apps.short_description: Restore a derelict East Village building in our cozy management sim. Scrub, paint, repair flat by flat, choose who moves in, win their trust and track the rumours that circulate. Most odd goings-on have a normal explanation. Not all. You have one year to save it from the property developer.

apps.name: The Last Debugger
apps.short_description: The Last Debugger is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where you collect equipment cards, combine powerful set effects, and plan around card speed and enemy intentions as four distinct characters fight through a broken game world.

apps.name: The Last Defender
apps.short_description: Hold your crashed colony against thousands of enemies that evolve from every wave. Build walls and turrets, command your colonists, read the swarm on your sensors and grow a new build every run, with permanent upgrades between runs. Solo or 1–4 player online co-op on PC & Mac.

apps.name: The Last Lesson
apps.short_description: A first-person horror puzzle game where technical problems have physical consequences. Solve challenge rooms, navigate procedural corridors, and survive the Teacher hunting you through the school.

apps.name: The Maze: In Dark
apps.short_description: With only a flashlight to rely on, secure your objective in the dark factory and escape while avoiding the gaze of 'Him', who roams the factory at random. Overcome the extreme fear of the unknown brought on by darkness and complete your assigned mission safely.

apps.name: The Midnight Client
apps.short_description: Run a late-night cafe in Tokyo, serve meals tailored to your regulars, and investigate the secrets behind their requests. Balance supplies, cooking and income with clues, conversations and relationships in this 2D single-player narrative adventure and management game.

apps.name: The Mirror Circle
apps.short_description: Naomi enters an abandoned mountain hotel searching for her missing sister. Armed only with a ritual mirror that reveals and purifies spirits, she must confront invisible horrors and uncover the truth hidden within the darkness.

apps.name: The Radiant Crest
apps.short_description: A farm boy inherits a crest that was never meant for him. Lead a growing band of companions through a kingdom at war, in a grid-based tactics RPG with the look of the handheld classics.

apps.name: The Reaper -Links Quartz Chapter 2-
apps.short_description: A 2D action game featuring scythe combat and character-driven dialogue.

apps.name: The Silence the Woods Keep
apps.short_description: 2D action with incremental progression and horror elements. Freely explore the forest, chop trees, and upgrade gear by day. By night, choose to risk it all for valuable resources while facing dangerous monsters with unique behaviors.

apps.name: The Tale of LUMI
apps.short_description: The Tale of LUMI is a fast paced, metroidvania inspired, action game. Collect powers from Gods and Heroes. Upgrade your Skills. Defeat unyielding enemies. Explore LUMI and unveil the secrets that lie within this puzzling Kingdom.

apps.name: The Tidy TeaShop:  Tidy Up The Tea Collection
apps.short_description: Tidy Up 2130 tea boxes with no spells or time limits in this cosy organising game. Read the labels and study the packaging to return every blend to its proper shelf. Organise the shop and help the occasional customer find the tea they want, always at your own peaceful pace.

apps.name: TicketRot: A Carnival Incremental Game
apps.short_description: A carnival incremental where you’re the only one left. Throw darts, whack moles, shoot hoops, wind up clockwork figures to play for you, and win relics from the claw machine. The midway rots a little more with every booth you bring back.

apps.name: Tidy Up Christmas Shop
apps.short_description: 2,490 Christmas items are scattered across the shop, and you are the one putting every single one back. No timer, no stress: a completely relaxing tidying game. Gather baubles, candles, mugs and gift boxes, place them on the right shelf and watch a huge two-storey shop fill up shelf by shelf.

apps.name: Tiny Legions
apps.short_description: Tiny Legions is an incremental strategy game that combines town building with army battles. Construct buildings to unlock troops, strengthen your hero, and build an army your way. Let your soldiers handle the fighting or take command when it matters.

apps.name: Tiny Lives
apps.short_description: You're a recent high school grad in a life sim where people have minds of their own. Your spouse can say no, your friends can bail, and your kids remember everything. Work, love, crime, and weird things in the woods. When your time is up, play on as your heir and see how far your family name goes.

apps.name: Tooth And Tusk
apps.short_description: Play as Dr. Chompers, a T-Rex dentist in a cozy miniature voxel clinic for animals. Scrape plaque, fill cavities, polish teeth, drain saliva, and forge custom grillz while rival Dr. Sterling heckles from across the street.

apps.name: Totally Under Control
apps.short_description: Build routes. Break rocks. Try to keep the robots in one piece. A comic 2D puzzle game on Mars: assign ten specialised jobs, control the flow of your crew and improvise a way home through 150 increasingly devious missions. It's Totally Under Control!

apps.name: Traincremental: A Cozy Clay Railway
apps.short_description: Attention passengers: due to high demand, this train will now carry even more passengers. A chill train incremental about huge crowds, piles of coins and a railway that never stops growing. Thank you for riding with us.

apps.name: TsundereSQL
apps.short_description: Type real SQL to answer each question in this anime visual novel. Every query you submit is checked against hidden data, across 224 problems in 14 modules, from your first SELECT to window functions, cohorts and messy production data. Romance can be switched off. English only.

apps.name: Tuftwood : Rug Tufting Simulation
apps.short_description: Tuft cozy rugs for a town full of customers. Stretch the cloth, fire the tufting gun, glue, flip, shave and carve each rug by hand, then deliver it to their home. Grow your little studio with new yarns, tools and decorations, or turn any picture into a rug of your own.

apps.name: Tulpa the Unseen Lover
apps.short_description: Create yourself a perfect friend in this choice-driven visual novel. Love her, hate her, don't let her turn your life into a living hell.

apps.name: Turika
apps.short_description:
Turika is a fast top-down action game for 1-8 players. Dungeons, monsters, weapons and loot - all the good stuff and moar!. No two dungeons are the same: the layout, monsters and prizes changes every time you go in.
Play with your friends online or on the couch. It's fun! It really is!

apps.name: Turnbuckle Hearts
apps.short_description: Turnbuckle Hearts is a visual novel set in the world of professional wrestling. Forge friendships, find romance, and fight for your future as your choices shape the story.

apps.name: Twisted Ball Pool
apps.short_description: Pool meets roguelite in a twisted funhouse carnival. Clear strangely shaped tables, stack abilities like Fireball and Local Shift, survive curses like the Death Ball, and pick your path to the Boss table. How far can one run take you?

apps.name: Ultimate Jello Party
apps.short_description: Ultimate Jello Party is a multiplayer party game that combines elements of card, board and minigame battles. Earn coins, plan your strategy and accumulate Jellos to win this chaotic competition full of nostalgic parodies for up to 4 players!

apps.name: Unblock Me Kingdom
apps.short_description: Slide the blocks, clear the exit, and find the move that changes everything. Unblockme offers 1,800 puzzles across six difficulty levels, eight visual themes, undo, and saved progress.

apps.name: UNDECLARED
apps.short_description: The ship is on credit and the office wants it back in sixteen trips. Pack a hold where every crate sets its neighbour's price, hide the contraband under lead where the customs beam can't reach, and make every payment. Three seizures and the run is over.

apps.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
apps.short_description: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

apps.name: Until somewhere
apps.short_description: WARNING! This game is harder than it looks – you’ll need to be a real go-getter. The aim is to build your shuttle and upgrade it so you can venture into the unknown depths of interstellar space. With only Lina, your faithful companion, by your side, will you have enough patience?

apps.name: Untitled Shop Game
apps.short_description: Untitled Shop Game is a shop simulator that lets you unleash your artistic side. There are 200+ decorations and no limits to how, what, or where you place items (well, except for placing stuff on the roads). Oh, and one more thing: the game includes a music player with over 50 songs!

apps.name: Used Car Dealer Simulator
apps.short_description:
Buy and sell used cars
Find cars at the right price, add them to your dealership, and sell them for profit.

Run your own car dealership
Manage your car lot, organize your vehicles, and grow your business step by step.

apps.name: V:ALIGN
apps.short_description: V:ALIGN is a turn-based card strategy game of placement, timing, and risk. Build scoring combinations, block spaces with WALL effects, call KOI-KOI to push for more points, and battle three AI difficulty levels or another player online through Steam.

apps.name: Vampire Tactics
apps.short_description: Vampire Tactics is a fast-paced tactical roguelite set in a dark fantasy world. Turn mortals into powerful vampires and make them join your ranks. Capture castles, evolve your minions, unlock new heroes, collect epic weapons and plunge the world into darkness!

apps.name: Vega Chronicle
apps.short_description: Lead your civilization to galactic glory in this bite-sized 4X strategy game. Build, colonize, trade, and, by tact or might, overcome all who oppose you.

apps.name: Village of the Ages
apps.short_description: Raise a village of quirky little people, turning their bright ideas into new tools, and steering them through the ages, fires, tornados and all. No tech trees, no progress bars: just a community that grows up and starts making its own choices.

apps.name: Vinyl Store : Tidy Up
apps.short_description: Bring order to a messy record shop. Pick up 4,000 records, sort them onto the right shelves by music genre, and watch the shop come together one record at a time. Upgrade your carrying capacity, put some music on, and take a moment to enjoy it.

apps.name: Vizarri
apps.short_description: A monster-taming RPG set on the planet of Valaar. Capture and train mystical creatures known by the locals as Vizarri. Battle other trainers in tactical, turn-based combat on a dynamic grid. Explore islands, collect items, and outsmart a rising enemy force. These are the Adventures of Valaar.

apps.name: Void Inc
apps.short_description:
Survive corporate horror in this surreal startup simulator.
A dark comedy, where you drink coffee, plan, get through the day, grow the startup, manage staff and explore the company and it's dark secrets.

apps.name: Void Privateers
apps.short_description: Take command of a mighty space warship! Unleash thunderous broadsides, issue voice commands to your crew, and chase fortune through daring contracts in a tactical space combat roguelite.

apps.name: Void Revenant
apps.short_description: Blast through 20 sectors in a pixel-art vertical shoot ’em up. Collect salvage, dock with an alien merchant and build an arsenal of lasers, missiles and drones. Break gigantic bosses, chase explosive combos and unlock new ships across four difficulties.

apps.name: Wasted Chef
apps.short_description: Prepare the finest dishes the judges have ever tasted or sabotage your rivals until their culinary creations become disasters. Compete in the most chaotic cooking competition ever created in this multiplayer party game for up to 4 players, and prove you have what it takes to become the Wasted Chef.

apps.name: We Don't Exist
apps.short_description: A single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You wake up in a facility where every room wants you dead and a voice records everything. The worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Training modes playable by two, online or in split screen.

apps.name: We Have a Sheep Problem
apps.short_description: Every sheep on the farm has escaped from its stand. Catch them, carry them home and put each one back in its own spot. Hats, costumes, a whole meadow of runaways and a few silly tools to help. A cosy, woolly tidy up game.

apps.name: Woodland Rebels
apps.short_description: Survive an untamed world where humans, animal villagers and wild animals all coexist, but not in harmony. Craft, farm, cook, and assign roles to villagers. Explore various biomes and muster an animal rebellion to fight back against human invaders.

apps.name: Woolfall
apps.short_description: Build a mine. Fill it with sheep. Route them past glowing caves for finer wool. Or flood it, burn it and blow it up, just to see what lava does to water. Sheep go poof and drift home. That's normal. Solo, or co-op with up to three friends to blame.

apps.name: World Series of Poker Game - WSOP
WORLDS: Anthropos
apps.short_description: Embark on the only story ever told. You are Maya, marooned on a hostile world with no memory of the fall that put you there. Ammunition, healing and life share one meter — you replenish it only by surviving. Seven worlds stand between you and the truth. Anthropos is the first.

apps.name: Wreck of The Narwhal: A Cleaning Mystery Game
apps.short_description: A cleaning and investigation game where you scrub the salvage found in a shipwreck and solve mysteries from the past. Clean the evidence to uncover clues, catalogue sea creatures, and identify the lost crew. Finally, reveal the secrets buried beneath the waves.

apps.name: You are the weapon
apps.short_description: Game has been delisted... Thanks gamers for playing...

apps.name: Youth Centre Simulator
apps.short_description: Build up your youth center: Hire staff, develop facilities, write and join EU-funded projects, and grow your organization while handling unexpected events.

apps.name: Yukikaki: Snow Plow Simulator
apps.short_description: Clear the snow one satisfying shovelful at a time. Start with a single shovel in a snowy Japanese town and end up clearing airport runways. Snow piles up where you throw it and banks up in front of your plow. Help twelve people around town at your own pace: no time limits, no fuel, no tool wear.

apps.name: Zaz Tower
apps.short_description: An incremental tower defense game: defend your tower against hordes attacking from every direction. Choose cards, combine powers, recruit heroes, and turn each defeat into permanent upgrades so you can return stronger.

apps.name: Zero Boundary Line
apps.short_description: This indie sci-fi TD has easy controls. Play as a futuristic commander defending humanity from mutants across diverse maps. Beat levels to unlock units: defenders, melee fighters, crowd controllers. Buy unique shop units, mix ability units for powerful custom defense lines.

apps.name: Zombie Industrial Complex
apps.short_description: Exterminate zombies using the might of the military industrial complex. In this active incremental game, you'll earn money by defeating zombies which can be used to buy weapons, purchase upgrades, call in airstrikes, and send in the tanks!

apps.name: Zone Idle
apps.short_description: An incremental extraction simulator set in a ruthless world inspired by the extraction genre and book Roadside Picnic. Manage your inventory, navigate hazardous events, and upgrade your hideout. Same tension, but with time to think.

apps.name: Магический мир Константина Кадавра
apps.short_description: Enter Konstantin Kadavr's absurd magical world through a refrigerator in the woods. Ask a video fortune orb, click for coins, catch flying bonuses, and test your patience to earn red chairs. The game is available in Russian only.

apps.name: Симулятор Сельского Курьера
apps.short_description: A very simple game with simulation elements. You’ll interact with the world around you, gather collectibles, and—most importantly—easily deliver packages! Who knows what else is hidden in this world...

apps.name: せれくとKiss +Plus
apps.short_description: Select Kiss +Plus is a lighthearted visual novel where you choose two people from a colorful cast of six and lock them inside “The Room You Can’t Leave Until You Kiss.”

apps.name: ドクロ・マグロ
apps.short_description: Awaken in a psychiatric hospital and become trapped in an endless loop of madness. Explore bizarre hellscapes, battle monstrous tuna creatures, and fight your way out of a surreal nightmare in this absurd escape horror FPS!

apps.name: 一发收工 Crystal Ricochet
apps.short_description: Aim, ricochet and ignite a glittering crystal chain. Solve 1000 increasingly demanding puzzles with simple mouse controls, limited shots and instant retries. Track your progress on a global leaderboard. A free 100-level demo is available.

apps.name: 噼啪碎碎砖
apps.short_description: Paw Pop Breakout is a fast-paced brick-breaking deckbuilding roguelike. Smash bricks and collect shards before time runs out. Your deck determines which bricks, power-ups, and obstacles appear. Build unique synergies, face random challenges, and break through the ever-increasing difficulty!

apps.name: 天启异境
apps.short_description: A diablo-like ARPG.

apps.name: 投資家になろう
apps.short_description: Start an investment company with JPY 100 million in 1956. Study financial reports, invest in shares, and acquire businesses. Reinvest dividends and sale proceeds, face changing economic conditions, and build your own conglomerate.

apps.name: 星商
apps.short_description: Buy low across a living star sector, decode hidden recipes, and build an empire of ships and space stations. A deterministic offline trading sim with pirates, guild wars, and a summit to reach — no internet required.

apps.name: 星糖學園
apps.short_description: Read enemy landings, turn cards into a squad on a 5×5 battlefield, and use positioning and Hero Skills to rewrite the outcome of auto-combat in this story-driven magical-academy deckbuilder.

apps.name: 是！陛下！
apps.short_description:
Outrageous!

A century on the throne—peace and prosperity across the realm—yet my flag covers but a speck on the map? I keep an elite army, and all they do is parade for me! Guards! A grand campaign begins!

— Yes! Your Majesty!

apps.name: 望长安
apps.short_description: Longing for Chang’an is a historical mystery visual novel set in the Middle Tang after the An Lushan Rebellion. An exiled aristocrat is drawn into a murder case that reveals a brutal power struggle in the Hexi Corridor, where every truth has a price and every choice shapes the frontier’s fate.

apps.name: 狂還 -CLOWNROT-
apps.short_description: A psychological survival horror set in an underground parking garage. Trapped in an inescapable otherworld, survive until 5 AM while obeying absurd rules and fleeing a relentless clown. Each attack eats away at your mind, drawing you closer to becoming one. Can you survive the night as a human?

apps.name: 狄神探
apps.short_description: Become a legendary detective of ancient China! In "Di Renjie: The Legendary Investigator", play as Di Renjie, solving thrilling cases across Bianzhou and Bingzhou in the Tang Dynasty and uncovering the truth.

apps.name: 研究生模拟器：毕业倒计时
apps.short_description: Read papers, build your thesis, join competitions, and manage stress, advisors, and peers. Meet your goals in 48 weeks and graduate with dignity.

apps.name: 裂界勇士
apps.short_description: Enter world rifts and fight chaos-corrupted dungeons. Ancient chaos threatens all worlds. As a Dimension Bureau warrior, explore unknown realms and stop its spread. Choose classes, use guns, blades, and magic. Build powerful combos, defeat monsters and Bosses in endless bullet storms.

apps.name: 負可敵國，債晶傳奇
apps.short_description: Fear creates strong will—and “they” are watching. They offer contracts: wishes come true, but debt follows. Meow Meow signed out of fear of poverty; Awo Awo chose the chains. No call to save the world—just an adventurer repaying debt, uncovering deeper rules through quests and choices.

apps.name: AquaDream Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The AquaDream Soundtracks pack includes the five original tracks from the game, composed by Joshua Liljeblad, along with their Reverb versions.

apps.name: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike Soundtrack

apps.name: Rhythm Doctor OST
apps.short_description: This is the official soundtrack to Rhythm Doctor, composed and produced by fizzd, celesti, Riya, and various guest artists!

apps.name: Saraab: Beyond The Veil Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Embark on an emotional journey with the original soundtrack to Saraab: Beyond the Veil, inspired by the music of 1990s and early 2000s RPGs. Featuring 16 tracks, with MP3 and optional high-quality WAV files.

apps.name: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy - Soundtrack1.1 -  Love-Colored Illusion: Papillon (feat. 本墨置子)
apps.short_description: This is additional content for Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy, but does not include the base game.

apps.name: 泥酔ローグとおしまいの吸血鬼 Soundtrack
apps.short_description: It's the Original Soundtrack of "Drunken Rogue", in "320kbps MP3" and "FLAC" formats. Over 108 tracks (including 1 unreleased track) by "NokiaPacket."

apps.name: 迷家 mygohome Soundtrack
apps.short_description: 12 original tracks for Mygohome, produced by a professional music team.

apps.name: Alien Covenant In Utero
apps.short_description: ALIEN: COVENANT In Utero is a 360-degree virtual reality journey into a living nightmare that offers a terrifyingly close and personal encounter as an alien neomorph at the time of its birth.

apps.name: Lego Batman 'The Batmersive Experience'
apps.short_description: Enter the Batcave to join the real LEGO® Batman for a Batmersive VR Experience.

apps.name: Making of Furi: Episode 1 - Conception
apps.short_description:
A series of mini-documentaries on the making of boss-fight game Furi by The Game Bakers.
Episode 1 - Conception: the vision for the game from the conception phase in 2014

apps.name: Oats Studios - Volume 1: RAKKA
apps.short_description: RAKKA is the story of broken humanity following the invasion of a technologically superior alien species. Bleak harrowing and unrelenting, the humans we meet must find enough courage to go on fighting.

apps.name: The Art of Playing
apps.short_description: Indie video game developers push games to new frontiers in storytelling, music, animation and design. Texas has the second largest concentration of game companies in the U.S.

apps.name: The Blank Canvas - Hacking Nature
apps.short_description:
The most disruptive ideas of our time exist in the intersection of biotech and information tech.
We’re leveraging the true potential of immersive technologies to make the ideas of some of the most brilliant minds of our time come to life, so you can experience and understand better those fields.

apps.name: Under the Canopy
apps.short_description: WATCH MORE 360 VIDEOS LIKE THIS IN THE JAUNT VR APP - The world’s greatest rainforest is also one of its most vital life-support systems — and it is under threat. Conservation International (CI) and Jaunt VR take viewers “Under the Canopy” to experience the wonders of the Amazon rainforest and appreciate why we need to protect it. In the piece, you will soar over treetops and plunge into rivers as you explore Earth’s most biodiverse ecosystem.
